description: One thing a pending restart waits for: a chat whose agent is running a command, a task's run, an agent run on this host for another host's chat (an Apple or pi model), or a terminal on this host that someone is attached to.

kind.description: A chat running a command, a task running, an agent run for a chat elsewhere, or an attached terminal.

session.description: The chat's id: a chat's, a task's Bot's, or the chat elsewhere an agent run is for.

host.description: An agent run's: the id of the host its chat is on.

task.description: A task run's: its task's id.

name.description: The chat's title, the task's name, the agent's model, or the terminal's title.

what.description: What it runs: the chat's oldest command, the agent run's chat's host, or the terminal's program.
